## Project Overview

Angular web application for merging two images pixel by pixel. Users can upload two images, and the application averages their pixel values to create a merged result.

### Features
- File upload for two images
- Live preview of selected images
- Pixel-by-pixel merging using canvas API
- Automatic scaling for different image dimensions
- Display merged result in browser
